declaredIdentity: tenant/work-digest-preferences/memberId; scalar values only, no explicit expected revision/request identity. Same values no-op but retry of old setting after a later update will change state again.
invariant: One member stores current notification consent and valid scheduling time zone; identical current setting is no-op. This is chiefly a settings state holder, with no multi-part business invariant identified.
boundaryRationale: Retain per-member notification consent/time-zone authority or equivalent dedicated versioned consent owner. Matching Member identity does not justify a shared revision. Add logical retry and expected revision so an old consent command cannot override later consent.
identityReadingRule: selectedIdentitySummary and exact selectedCommandContracts define intended identity. baselineIdentityObservation/declaredIdentity retain older source observations only, including old replay defects; they are not target behavior or authorization to change an occupied key.
baselineIdentityObservation: tenant/work-digest-preferences/memberId; scalar values only, no explicit expected revision/request identity. Same values no-op but retry of old setting after a later update will change state again.
identityContractRule: Existing published owner identity/IdFor remains stable. Required typed creation/operation identity and tenant/program/source scope come from the selected signature/protocol references; no context.RequestId minting fallback or guessed new stream key.
selectedIdentityClarification: Tenant / work-digest-preferences / MemberId. Selected CommandId binds the exact preference update; unchanged values still have an original recorded result under the adopted preference decision.
selectedIdentitySummary: Tenant / work-digest-preferences / MemberId. Selected CommandId binds the exact preference update; unchanged values still have an original recorded result under the adopted preference decision.
selectedReplayRule: Current required authorization precedes replay; exact authorized retries resolve the original accepted result using the selected logical identity and immutable actor/intent/source binding. Fresh mutable feasibility, clock selection and body preparation cannot replace that original result. Expected revision is concurrency precondition, not a new identity.

reclassification.rationale: Stores one member's notification consent and time zone; identical setting is a no-op. No multi-part business invariant. WorkDigestPreferenceRecorded remains a retained emission consumed by WeeklyWorkDigest scheduling.
